ModuleMeta.Name: Stock Domain
ModuleMeta.Description: Overall stock state and inventory health.

Principle.name: Single Responsibility
Principle.Description: Aggregates stock data across all items, locations, and reservations to provide inventory health metrics.
Principle.Rationale: High-level view of stock health without per-item detail.

Features.Feature: Stock as Single Number: Tracking only total quantity without location information.

AntiPattern.name: Stock is multi-location. Always track per-location
AntiPattern.Avoid: Proceeding without validation or proper configuration.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Always validate inputs and follow documented patterns.
